notes:
- fix(security): a page whose images or scripts carry bad certificates no longer raises a warning for each one; only the page you asked for can ask
- feat(security): choosing "continue anyway" is remembered for that site and that exact certificate, so the page's own stylesheets and scripts load with it
- fix(security): signing out drops every certificate you allowed, so the next person on a shared machine does not inherit them
- fix(security): after refusing a certificate warning, going back to the site yourself asks again instead of failing silently
- fix(ui): a warning that runs to several lines is no longer cut off; the box grows to fit its text
- feat(ui): every message box has a way out, with a Close button on any that would otherwise have none
- feat(ui): a page that keeps opening dialogs offers to stop showing them from the third one onward
- fix(ui): a page can no longer reset that offer by reloading itself
- fix(security): the exam security block matches the rest of the browser and still refuses every way out except Un-enrol and Log out
- feat(ui): the sidebar, find bar, save-password prompt, sign-in window and popup windows use drawn icons instead of emoji and text symbols
- feat(ui): the password and history pages use drawn icons instead of emoji
- feat(ui): the loading spinner is a turning circle instead of a row of dots
- fix(ui): a sleeping tab and a tab playing audio are marked with proper icons
- fix(ui): the hover highlight on a sidebar tab's close button is centred on the icon instead of sitting beside it
- feat(ui): the account menu is larger, with bigger text and sharper icons
- fix(ui): moving through the account menu with the arrow keys shows which item is selected
- fix(ui): the find bar is more compact and its match count no longer leaves a gap
- fix(ui): a popup window's header uses the dark theme instead of a light grey bar
- fix(updater): the release notes stay on screen while an update downloads, and after a download fails
